def get_payment_summary():
    total_revenue = 0
    total_refunded = 0
    payment_count = len(_payment_db.values())
    
    # Filter payments to include only those with status 'completed'
    completed_payments = [p for p in _payment_db.values() if p.status == PaymentStatus.COMPLETED.value]
    
    for payment in completed_payments:
        total_revenue += payment.amount
    
    # Refund revenue is already included in the paid amount
    # But we need to add it back because refunded payments are still counted as active subscribers
    total_refunded = sum(payment.refunded_amount for payment in completed_payments if payment.status == PaymentStatus.REFUNDED.value)
    
    active_subscribers = len([p for p in _payment_db.values() if p.status not in [PaymentStatus.FAILED.value, PaymentStatus.REFUNDED.value]])
    
    return {
        "total_revenue": round(total_revenue, 2),
        "total_refunded": round(total_refunded, 2),
        "payment_count": payment_count,
        "active_subscribers": active_subscribers
    }
